The league title sponsor is [[Ping An Insurance]].{{cite web|url=http://sports.sohu.com/20140609/n400599939.shtml|title=中国平安4年6亿冠名中超 三大层面助力中国足球|work=Sohu Sports|date=2014-06-09|access-date=2018-10-01|language=zh}}{{cite web|url=http://sports.qq.com/a/20170518/028790.htm|title=中国平安继续冠名中超五年 总额达10亿人民币|work=Tencent Sports|date=2017-05-18|access-date=2018-10-01|language=zh}} [[Jiangsu F.C.|Jiangsu]] were the defending champions, but they folded on 28 February 2021, and were disqualified by the [[Chinese Football Association]] on 29 March 2021. ==Club changes== '''Clubs promoted from [[2020 China League One]]''' * [[Changchun Yatai F.C.|Changchun Yatai]] '''Dissolved entries''' * [[Jiangsu F.C.|Jiangsu]] (Jiangsu Suning) Changchun Yatai returns to the division after a 2-year absence. Cangzhou Mighty Lions were reprieved from relegation after finishing bottom in the previous season due to the dissolution of Jiangsu. ===Name changes=== {{See also|:zh:中国足协俱乐部名称中性化}} In December 2020, the CFA issued a policy to "neutralize" the names of all professional football clubs.{{cite web|url=https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202012/07/WS5fcd9917a31024ad0ba9a438.html |title= Renaming rules spell dilemma for Super League teams |publisher=China Daily|date=7 December 2020|access-date=29 December 2020}} Club names cannot contain any term of a sponsorship or commercial nature, and non-Chinese characters cannot be used.{{cite news |author1=程善 |title=为何集体对中性名一刀切不满？曾有一项合理动议 |url=https://sports.sina.com.cn/china/j/2020-12-07/doc-iiznctke5175518.shtml |accessdate=2021-01-29 |work=足球报 |date=2020-12-07 |archive-date=2021-02-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210203155318/https://sports.sina.com.cn/china/j/2020-12-07/doc-iiznctke5175518.shtml }}{{cite news |author1=祁东 |title=中国足协：俱乐部全部使用中性名，不得含有商号或品牌名称 |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_10384571 |accessdate=2021-01-29 |work=澎湃新闻 |date=2020-12-14 |archive-date=2021-02-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210202232154/https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_10384571 }} Most Chinese football clubs had to be renamed. There were some debates as to whether or not some long-existing club names, for example, "[[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Shandong Taishan]]" and "[[Beijing Guoan F.C.|Beijing Guoan]]", were acceptable. After [[Henan F.C.|Henan Jianye]] was renamed to "Henan Luoyang Longmen", club fans protested in front of the club stadium. changes == The CFA imposed a [[salary cap]] on the Super League in December 2020, taking effect with the 2021 season. Each club's total player wages are capped at ¥600 million, with a separate limit of €10 million for foreign players.
